description: Jordan Reyes sends the cold email to Mark Cuban's public email address.
Mark Cuban opens his email inbox and scans the subject lines of new messages. Jordan Reyes's email is visible in the list but has not yet been opened or read.
Jordan Reyes closes his email tab and resumes reviewing his startup's data models.
Jordan Reyes opens his email inbox and sees no new messages from Mark Cuban's domain.
Jordan continues reviewing his startup's data models on his computer.
Jordan switches to his email tab and opens his inbox. The inbox displays the list of emails; there is no new message from Mark Cuban's domain since his last check.
Jordan switches back to his data models and continues reviewing them.
